description: Use when the user asks which name servers a domain uses, who hosts its DNS (from the NS names) or whether they are redundant. Returns the NS set with addresses (up to eight); flags a single server, unresolvable ones, one network and missing glue. Ex: 'Which name servers does example.com use?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.

name: nameservers
title: Name server check
